items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: a guy named Morris that played drums with, I think -- what's the guy that had the band down at the Horseshoe? He was a drummer with -- down at the Diamond Horseshoe for a long time.

ctx.x: I had to pay ten percent. It was all right. But now, when I joined, then I had to -- I couldn't work with any traveling musicians then. I had to work with only 802 musicians six months. And so -- and a guy named Morris that played drums with, I think -- what's the guy that had the band down at the Horseshoe? He was a drummer with -- down at the Diamond Horseshoe for a long time.
Morris, I don't know a Morris.
